$doc: Project config for the html-to-figma tools. Paths are relative to this file's folder (figma-bridge/).
name: Website

sections.$doc: JS expressions over `sec` (a DOM element), evaluated in the rendered page.

chrome.$doc: Header/Footer content used by components/90-chrome.js. Fill from the site's header and footer.

$pagesDoc: One entry per frame. Required: group, name, file. Optional: figmaPage, x, y, prepare (JS run in the page before extraction: UI state), header (Header variant props), sections (selector/layout override), chrome (true | "header" | false), height (fixed screen), device ("mobile"), drawer ({layout, width, side}). Several entries may share a file (wizard steps, tabs, mobile).
